about: Proverbs is full of wise sayings that teach us how to live God's way.

pages.title: Wise Sayings
pages.text: King Solomon wrote wise sayings for children. "Listen to your father and mother." "Trust the Lord with all your heart, and don't lean on what you think you know." Loving God is where wisdom begins.
pages.lesson: Trust God with all your heart.

pages.title: Learn from the Ant
pages.scene: Ants carrying food into their hill
pages.text: "Go look at the ant! No one tells it what to do. But it works hard all summer, storing food for later." Ants are tiny, but they teach us a big lesson: work hard and don't be lazy.

pages.title: Kind Words
pages.text: "A gentle answer stops anger. Harsh words make it worse." "Kind words are like honey, sweet and good for you." The words we say can help people or hurt them, so choose kind ones.
